g.title: G01: explicit design-schematic function guess to Maxon ESCON 70/10 · J5 digital I/O screw terminal position 1 (DigIN1). FUNCTION GUESS ONLY, not a direct cable or a fitted conductor. Basis: DOTTED GUESS: CubeFactory names an ESCON 70/10 for its brushless recycler motor. Maxon permits a configured digital input as PWM set-value input, and its DigIN1 input is compatible with a bounded logic-level signal. The proposed SmoothieBox PWM TOOL output is itself an unqualified/candidate interface; neither the installed carrier circuit nor this ESCON mode/configuration is verified. Interface: PWM only; verify PWM voltage, polarity, frequency, duty range, DigIN1 function and failsafe against the exact fitted units before any connection. Checks: Identify the installed SmoothieBox carrier and verify its PWM TOOL screw really produces a buffered waveform within the ESCON DigIN1 0–36 V rating and logic thresholds.; Confirm SmoothieBox firmware PWM frequency and duty remain within Maxon DigIN1 PWM limits (10 Hz–5 kHz and 10–90%).; Confirm the ESCON is configured for PWM set-value on DigIN1; do not assume factory or project configuration.; Verify safe enable, interlock, stop behavior and motor-controller configuration independently; PWM command is not a safety inhibit.; Verify common signal reference and ground potential before connecting a return; avoid tying unlike supply or protective-earth nodes.; Confirm exact fitted ESCON 70/10 variant, J5 terminal identification, and CubeFactory machine wiring from direct inspection/continuity.

G02: explicit design-schematic function guess to Maxon ESCON 70/10 · J5 digital I/O screw terminal position 5 (GND signal). FUNCTION GUESS ONLY, not a direct cable or a fitted conductor. Basis: DOTTED GUESS: a signal reference may be required between SmoothieBox PWM TOOL GND and the ESCON J5 signal GND for the proposed DigIN1 PWM signal. Ground compatibility and the installed carrier path are unknown; this is a validation-dependent reference candidate, not a verified shared return. Interface: Signal-reference candidate for J5.1 PWM; no motor or heater current may use this signal ground. Checks: Measure and verify the grounds are compatible and at safe potential before joining them.; Confirm J5.5 is the signal reference used by the configured DigIN1 input.; Check no motor, heater, or supply return current would be carried through this signal connection.; Confirm isolation or interface conditioning requirements from exact installed hardware.

svg.text: DOTTED VIOLET = FUNCTION GUESS ONLY. Paths start at the actual drawn exterior screw and end at the named machine contact.
No installed continuity or direct cable is established.
OPEN / hollow contact = no SmoothieBox route selected in this study. This does not mean an electrically open circuit, unused pin
or NC in the source. Source-empty, unlisted and untranscribed roles remain distinct in their labels.
REFERENCE ONLY = a named source revision, not the installed machine. Reference contacts stay OPEN unless an individually cited
dotted function guess is shown. Named hardware with no contact map has an OPEN boundary, not invented '?' pins.
Paths may cross without joining; pale crossing clearance means NO JUNCTION. Multiple guesses from one screw are alternatives
unless each shares an explicit FAN-OUT tag. A tagged fan-out still needs separate buffers and load validation. No return bus is
Exterior label colors: black = circuit GND; red = 3.3 V; orange = 5 V; yellow/gold = load/control feed; blue/violet/green =
STEP/DIR/ENABLE. Dotted violet is an evidence state, not a reported cable color. Protective earth is not circuit GND.
DB25, DB44 and 15-contact D-sub housings are outside SmoothieBox. Contact strips preserve source order, not physical pin-row
geometry. USB device, USB host, Ethernet and microSD are separate service ports.
RESEARCH DIAGRAM — NOT QUALIFIED FOR PHYSICAL WIRING. Confirm the actual carrier, machine revision, mating view, electrical
interface, protection, returns and safety design before construction.
